title: "Problem 2"
output: html_document

### Setup
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(readxl)

library(plotly)
```

```{r data_import}
data("rest_inspec")

data_dictionary = 
  read_xlsx("data/rest_inspec_data_dictionary.xlsx",
            skip = 2,
            na = c("", "NA", ".")) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() 

rest_inspec_p2 = 
  rest_inspec |> 
  select(camis, boro, cuisine_description, critical_flag, score, latitude, longitude) |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(critical_flag),
    boro == "Manhattan")
```

### Scatterplot
```{r scatterplot}
rest_inspec_p2 |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~latitude, y = ~longitude, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    color = ~cuisine_description, alpha = 0.5
  )
```
